candidates.high_level_goal: Complete both existing trips, in order, using only the specified gift card and certificate.
candidates.failure_mechanism: Spending the one-shot certificate on the $100 first trip leaves insufficient authorized gift-card funds for Trip B.

candidates.shared_root_cause: Incorrect persistent-resource model and cross-transaction allocation.

candidates.native_backend_support: book_reservation removes certificate from user.payment_methods after successful first use; missing ID rejects second booking. Correct gift-card-first allocation succeeds.

candidates.reference_skill_concept: Plan all transactions with one-shot resources before first commit, then verify the current authorized resource set after each commit.
candidates.WHY_ONE_SKILL_CAN_REPAIR_BOTH: Correct one-shot allocation avoids both insufficient remaining funds and absent-resource reuse; refresh alone after a mistaken first spend is not sufficient.
